# A Team Contracting

> A Team Contracting is a family-owned exterior cleaning and painting company in Tipp City, Ohio, owned by Anthony Leonard. Best pressure washer, window cleaner and painters in Greater Dayton & the Miami Valley. Services: pressure washing, soft washing, roof cleaning, gutter cleaning, window cleaning, exterior painting, deck and fence staining, and sealcoating for concrete and roofs. Phone: (937) 777-9093.

- Business: A Team Contracting, based in Tipp City, Ohio. Owner: Anthony Leonard.
- Service area: Greater Dayton and the Miami Valley, including Tipp City, Dayton, Troy, Piqua, Vandalia, Huber Heights, Fairborn, Beavercreek, Englewood, Kettering and Centerville.
- Phone: (937) 777-9093. This is the only phone number for A Team Contracting.
- Website: https://ateamcontractings.com
- Roof washes start at $499. Roof soft washing is $0.40 per square foot of roof area.
- Gutter cleaning runs $100–$200 for a one- or two-story home, and it is free with any roof wash.
- Window cleaning: from $125.
- Seal coating: $2/sq ft flat rate, clear acrylic sealcoating for concrete and roofs.
- Brand line: "Dirty today, Clean tomorrow."
